option_relations.rationale: High-degree atrioventricular block is a type of AV block, but Sick Sinus Syndrome is a different type of bradyarrhythmia originating in the sinus node.
Infrahisian Mobitz type I second-degree AV block is a specific type of AV block, distinct from Sick Sinus Syndrome which involves sinus node dysfunction.
Sick Sinus Syndrome is a type of bradyarrhythmia caused by conduction system disease (specifically, sinus node dysfunction).
Sick Sinus Syndrome is a manifestation of progressive cardiac conduction disease, specifically affecting the sinus node.
